title: Per-Agent MCP Server Allowlist
description: Defines which MCP servers an agent is permitted to use, added to agent frontmatter

name.description: MCP server name as registered in settings.json

tools_allowed.description: Specific tool names allowed (empty = all tools)

required.description: Whether this server is required for the agent to function

mcp_servers.description: List of MCP servers this agent may access

mcp_deny.description: MCP server names explicitly denied (overrides any allowlist)
